about: Original MS-DOS programs held locally, as ToyVM would have to run them: the DOS payload itself, never the Windows DOSBox.exe a GOG release wraps it in. Payloads stay where they are (gitignored); tools/toyvm-dos-corpus.js reads them in place and writes manifest.json and files/<id>.json. Entry commands come from each release's own DOSBox [autoexec] or batch file, cited per title.

no-dpmi.text: ToyVM implements no DPMI host (INT 31h); INT 2Fh AX=1687h discovery is unhandled, not a complete DPMI absence protocol.
no-dpmi.cite: tools/toyvm/dos.js serviceCall (no 0x31); docs/dos-corpus-blockers.md "We implement no DPMI (INT 31h)"

paging.text: ToyVM implements 386 paging; paging support alone does not qualify an extender or game.

pm-dos-16bit.text: DOS calls made from protected mode are served with 16-bit offsets, so a flat-model caller passing 32-bit pointers is not served correctly.
pm-dos-16bit.cite: tools/toyvm/dos.js lin() masks the offset to 16 bits

extenders-run.text: DOS/4GW/CauseWay support is not globally qualified; individual reviewed routes remain scoped. The 2026-10-07 original Daggerfall CauseWay entry reached protected mode but stopped in a repeated decode-failure path; missing DPMI alone is not an observed cause.

flat-fs.text: ToyVM resolves every DOS path by its basename in one flat directory; there are no subdirectories (no MKDIR/CHDIR).

no-mscdex.text: ToyVM implements no CD-ROM / MSCDEX (INT 2Fh AX=15xx) and cannot mount a disc image.

no-mpu401.text: ToyVM has no MPU-401 MIDI device; ports 0x330/0x331 read 0xFF. Sound Blaster, OPL and GUS are implemented.
no-mpu401.cite: tools/toyvm/dos.js port table; tools/toyvm/audio.js, opl.js, gus.js

no-vbe2-lfb.text: ToyVM implements VBE 1.2 banked modes only; the VBE 2.0 linear framebuffer is refused.

sync-reads.text: ToyVM reads a file whole and synchronously when it is opened, so every file a live session might open must be downloaded before boot; there is no on-demand fetch.
sync-reads.cite: tools/toyvm/dos.js open (readFileSync of the whole file); tools/toyvm/bundle-browser.js mount

no-batch.text: ToyVM has no COMMAND.COM: EXEC runs .EXE/.COM programs (and `COMMAND.COM /C prog`), never a batch file.

exec.text: ToyVM implements DOS EXEC (INT 21h 4Bh, AL=00/01), so a launcher can start the next program.

no-browser-mouse.text: The browser live page wires keyboard only; INT 33h mouse exists in the CLI but no pointer events reach a live session.

evidence.summary: CLI probe (run-dos.js, origin/main 9df4dc30): ULTIMA.COM started the title program, EGA 320x200, rendered the correct title screen; still running and polling the keyboard when the 200M-dispatch budget ended. No keys sent. One unhandled DOS call: INT 21h AH=2Ah (get date).

Browser /toyvm/ session (headless Chrome, paced 10 MIPS, sound off): the title screen drew, and after Enter the game showed its own main menu (Options: Return to the view / Journey Onward / Initiate New Game), personally viewed -- keyboard input reaches the guest. Character creation and gameplay not attempted.

Ordinary Initiate New Game, Codex name and Male accepted; Space advanced illustrated portal story. Original170s work guard ended before completed creation/world; no game fault or gameplay qualification. Journey Onward packaged save was not used.
